sources.title: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 is an 8-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model created by mistralai for local deployment and edge computing. The model contains 8,019,808,256 parameters across 36 transformer layers with a dense architecture, achieving state-of-the-art performance for its size class.
